name.baseName: Uranium natural, in yellowcake, at mill plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: All necessary electricity is assumed to be produced on site by diesel generators. Chemical requirements as well as non radioactive emissions to air are averaged over several references describing operation of mills in the early 1980s in North America. Radioactive emissions to air and water as well as non radioactive emissions to water are also averaged values including information from early 1990s. Losses of uranium in milling are arbitrarily assumed 5% of the input uranium. The infrastructure requirement are calculated the production and the lifetime of the model mill.; UUID: 76021317-f4e1-383f-bfea-c1ad21ca2246

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average conditions.

# Included processes
The module includes: the land use for the operation (mostly tailings); diesel generators and industrial boilers burning light oil; transport of the chemicals and fuels; radioactive and non-radioactive emissions to air and water during operation; water use (mining water, but attributed to "unspecified natural origin").
